Priya (AE): Quick sync - Prospect 'CedarCare' asked for a 10-day POC to validate SSO (Okta), SCIM provisioning, delegated RBAC, DNS TXT domain proofing, and CMK for keys. They flagged HIPAA and want audit trails. Can someone own tech presales?

Tom L: I can. Need their SAML metadata, a SCIM sandbox (50 users), and a churn profile. Also call out whether they want user->role mappings or group-based RBAC.

Anika - Sec: From security: HIPAA in scope, CMK required, and provisioning audit logs must be retained 1 year. We need the security questionnaire PDF. Also ask if they require encrypted SAML assertions.

Platform-Eng: We can run an ephemeral private POC (private control plane) in ~4 business days if infra details provided. For SCIM, hosted default is 60s delta; Dedicated can do ~10s with tuned workers. Please provide expected API calls/sec during POC.

PricingOps: Pricing note - ephemeral private POC will incur a setup fee + minimum monthly. Hosted POC can use credits but may not support CMK/VPC. Ill prepare two scenarios once we have churn numbers.

Priya (AE): Action items: Tom - collect metadata + sandbox by EOD tomorrow. Platform-Eng - can you open the infra ticket for ephemeral POC with CMK option? Anika - standby to review security questionnaire. I'll loop Legal if needed.

InfraBot: Infra ticket #13422 created: private-poc-cedarcare, CMK:true, VPC-peering:pending.

Tom L: Pinged CedarCare for artifacts. Will update thread when I get the sandbox credentials. :white_check_mark:
